## Dependencies

### Internal

- **`odoo.service.security`** — User credential & session validation; used in model.py dispatch()
- **`odoo.service.common`** — RPC version/auth entry points; dispatched from RPC protocol handlers
- **`odoo.service.db`** — Database management RPC; dispatched from RPC protocol handlers
- **`odoo.service.model`** — ORM method dispatch; called by client RPC handlers
- **`odoo.modules.registry.Registry`** — Core ORM registry; accessed in model.py, db.py, server.py for cursor management
- **`odoo.api`** — ORM environment & method calling (call_kw, Environment); used in model.py
- **`odoo.exceptions`** — AccessDenied, ValidationError, AccessError, UserError; used throughout
- **`odoo.tools.config`** — Global configuration object; used in all modules
- **`odoo.tools.sql`** — SQL utilities (SQL, table_exists); used in db.py
- **`odoo.tools.misc`** — Utilities (email_split, find_pg_tool, exec_pg_environ); used in db.py
- **`odoo.release`** — Version metadata; used in common.py, db.py

### External

- **`psycopg2@2.9+`** — PostgreSQL driver; used in db.py, model.py for connection management & error handling
- **`werkzeug@2.0+`** — WSGI server framework; used in server.py for HTTP/WebSocket servers
- **`psutil@5.0+`** — Process/memory monitoring; used in server.py for memory_info() and limits
- **`pytz`** — Timezone library; used in db.py for country timezone mapping
- **`decorator`** — Function decorator utility; used in db.py for check_db_management_enabled
- **`inotify` (optional)** — Linux file watcher; used in server.py for autoreload on Linux
- **`watchdog` (optional)** — Cross-platform file watcher; used in server.py for autoreload on non-Linux
- **`setproctitle` (optional)** — Process title management; used in server.py Worker for process naming
- **`gevent` (optional)** — Async library; used in GeventServer for async HTTP serving

## Relationships

Dispatcher pattern: common/security/model/db modules each implement dispatch(method, params) that routes RPC method names to corresponding exp_* functions. These are chained through the Odoo RPC protocol layer.

Server architecture: CommonServer is the base for three deployment modes (ThreadedServer, GeventServer, PreforkServer), each managing HTTP request processing differently. Worker classes (WorkerHTTP, WorkerCron) are used only in PreforkServer for process-based concurrency.

Request handling: RequestHandler and ThreadedWSGIServerReloadable manage low-level HTTP details (WebSocket upgrade, header deduplication, socket activation). FileSystem watchers (FSWatcherBase and subclasses) enable development-time autoreload.

## Notes for Higher-Level Synthesis

- **RPC Protocol Boundary**: common.py, security.py, model.py, and db.py form the RPC protocol layer — they are boundary code that translates network requests into ORM calls. Belongs with client-facing protocol handlers (e.g., odoo.http, odoo.addons.base.handlers).

- **Server Infrastructure**: server.py is independent utility code for HTTP/worker lifecycle management; does not depend on business logic and should be grouped separately in a Web Server Infrastructure component.

- **Shared Authentication Model**: security.py and model.py both validate credentials and session tokens via the same res.users ORM model — they belong together in an authentication component alongside odoo.http.request session handling.

- **Database Management vs. Execution**: db.py (database lifecycle) and model.py (method execution) are orthogonal — db.py manages the database itself, model.py executes methods within a database. Both are part of the RPC layer but should be documented as separate logical components.
